episodes.title: Part I
episodes.summary: When agents of the Empire pose a new threat, Obi-Wan Kenobi emerges after years of hiding.

episodes.title: Part II
episodes.summary: On a dangerous crime-ridden world, Obi-Wan becomes a target.

episodes.title: Part III
episodes.summary: Obi-Wan searches for allies as he attracts the attention of the Empire, threatening the locals.

episodes.title: Part IV
episodes.summary: Obi-Wan Kenobi plots a daring mission into enemy territory.

episodes.title: Part V
episodes.summary: Obi-Wan plans his next move as the Imperial forces attempt to draw him out.

episodes.title: Part VI
episodes.summary: Obi-Wan is drawn into a confrontation with Vader, as Luke's fate hangs in the balance.
